name: Berechiah
overview: Berechiah was a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified specifically as the son of Asa according to 1 Chronicles 9:16. Beyond this unique attribute, Scripture provides no additional notes or details about his life or role. His mention situates him within the Levitical lineage, which was significant for priestly and temple duties.
namesAndTitles: The name Berechiah is a proper name meaning 'YHWH blesses.' This theophoric name reflects a common biblical practice of embedding God's name within personal names, indicating a recognition of divine blessing. There are no titles or additional names recorded for him.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Berechiah as the son of Asa, as noted in 1 Chronicles 9:16. No other family relationships are documented in the biblical text beyond this father-son connection.
scriptureSignificance: Berechiah's significance lies primarily in his identification within the Levitical genealogy, emphasizing the continuity of the priestly line. His mention in 1 Chronicles 9:16 highlights the careful preservation of Levitical descendants who were essential for temple service and worship in Israel. Though little else is recorded about him, his inclusion underlines the faithfulness of God in maintaining His covenant through the tribe of Levi.
